samples.xml_description:
<module id="alu">
    <description>ALU for a 32-bit MIPS-ISA CPU.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">32-bit input operand A.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">32-bit input operand B.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit control signal for selecting the operation to be performed.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">32-bit output representing the result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">1-bit output indicating whether the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">1-bit output indicating whether a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative">1-bit output indicating whether the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">1-bit output indicating whether an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag">1-bit output representing a general flag, which is set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="ADD">6'b100000</parameter>
        <parameter name="ADDU">6'b100001</parameter>
        <parameter name="SUB">6'b100010</parameter>
        <parameter name="SUBU">6'b100011</parameter>
        <parameter name="AND">6'b100100</parameter>
        <parameter name="OR">6'b100101</parameter>
        <parameter name="XOR">6'b100110</parameter>
        <parameter name="NOR">6'b100111</parameter>
        <parameter name="SLT">6'b101010</parameter>
        <parameter name="SLTU">6'b101011</parameter>
        <parameter name="SLL">6'b000000</parameter>
        <parameter name="SRL">6'b000010</parameter>
        <parameter name="SRA">6'b000011</parameter>
        <parameter name="SLLV">6'b000100</parameter>
        <parameter name="SRLV">6'b000110</parameter>
        <parameter name="SRAV">6'b000111</parameter>
        <parameter name="LUI">6'b001111</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <signal id="res" width_description="[31:0]" type="wire">Result register.</signal>
        <signal id="signed_a" width_description="[31:0]" type="wire">Signed version of input A.</signal>
        <signal id="signed_b" width_description="[31:0]" type="wire">Signed version of input B.</signal>
        <signal id="shift_amount" width_description="[4:0]" type="wire">Shift amount.</signal>
        <signal id="temp_res" width_description="[31:0]" type="wire">Temporary result.</signal>
        <signal id="temp_flag" width_description="[0:0]" type="wire">Temporary flag.</signal>
        <signal id="temp_zero" width_description="[0:0]" type="wire">Temporary zero.</signal>
        <signal id="temp_negative" width_description="[0:0]" type="wire">Temporary negative.</signal>
        <signal id="temp_overflow" width_description="[0:0]" type="wire">Temporary overflow.</signal>
        <signal id="temp_carry" width_description="[0:0]" type="wire">Temporary carry.</signal>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        assign signed_a = $signed(a);
        assign signed_b = $signed(b);
        assign shift_amount = (aluc == SLL || aluc == SRL || aluc == SRA || aluc == SLLV || aluc == SRLV || aluc == SRAV) ? a[4:0] : 5'b0;
        
        always @(*) begin
            temp_res = 32'b0;
            temp_flag = 1'b0;
            temp_zero = 1'b0;
            temp_negative = 1'b0;
            temp_overflow = 1'b0;
            temp_carry = 1'b0;
            
            case (aluc)
                ADD: temp_res = signed_a + signed_b;
                ADDU: temp_res = a + b;
                SUB: temp_res = signed_a - signed_b;
                SUBU: temp_res = a - b;
                AND: temp_res = a & b;
                OR: temp_res = a | b;
                XOR: temp_res = a ^ b;
                NOR: temp_res = ~(a | b);
                SLT: begin
                    temp_res = signed_a < signed_b ? 32'b1 : 32'b0;
                    temp_flag = 1'b1;
                end
                SLTU: begin
                    temp_res = a < b ? 32'b1 : 32'b0;
                    temp_flag = 1'b1;
                end
                SLL: temp_res = {32'b0, a << shift_amount};
                SRL: temp_res = a >> shift_amount;
                SRA: temp_res = a >>> shift_amount;
                SLLV: temp_res = {32'b0, a << (b[4:0])};
                SRLV: temp_res = a >> (b[4:0]);
                SRAV: temp_res = a >>> (b[4:0]);
                LUI: temp_res = {a[15:0], 16'b0};
                default: temp_res = 32'bZ;
            endcase
            
            r = temp_res;
            zero = temp_res == 32'b0 ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
            negative = temp_res[31];
            overflow = (aluc == ADD || aluc == SUB) && ((signed_a[31] == signed_b[31]) != (signed_a[31] == temp_res[31]));
            carry = (aluc == ADDU || aluc == SUBU) && (a[31] == b[31]) != (a[31] == temp_res[31]);
            flag = temp_flag;
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
